decision_reason: Brier 0.21908 on locked 2023-2025 beats naive constant home-win-rate baseline 0.24758; reliability deciles all within 0.09 of observed, monotonic.

fit.data: data/games_with_preds_v2.parquet, seasons 2021-2022 walk-forward out-of-sample V1 ensemble predictions
fit.excluded: exact ties (home_margin == 0) dropped from fit and validation
fit.regime: same 2021-2022 predictions used for V2 gating

mapping.input: V1 predicted home margin (model_spread, full precision)
mapping.spec: logistic regression on predicted margin only; no other features

market_win_prob: NOT included: no moneyline data in market JSONs (spread/total pairs only); never approximated.
note: Derived layer only. V1 predictions, weights, ratings, and thresholds are untouched; this mapping cannot change any spread, pick, or edge.

validation.baseline: naive constant empirical home-win rate on validation set
validation.data: data/games_with_preds_v2.parquet, seasons 2023-2025 walk-forward out-of-sample predictions (locked test regime; never used for fitting)
validation.reliability: decile bins of predicted P vs observed home-win rate; all gaps < 0.10, observed rates monotonic in predicted
